notes: Brand new PR, opened 2026-09-06T07:59:25Z by Alek99 (MEMBER). Part of the Sep 5-7 performance-PR batch; adds a per-project frontend install lock (POSIX flock / Windows msvcrt retry lock) held across the full install transaction, so two concurrent Reflex processes can't corrupt .web / the procedure cache / lockfiles by installing at the same time. Also makes procedure-cache and package-manager file writes atomic.
